This '''star system''' was located within the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] within which was located [[Desolation Station/Legends|Desolation Station]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] construction facility used to build components of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]]. Desolation Station was [[Mission to Desolation Station|destroyed]] during a mission led by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel operative]] [[X2]].<ref name="Elite">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>
